message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Fresh sweep completed for the 24-hour window ending 2026-06-05 05:10 IST, using the monitored product list in Products.txt. I found three credible newly reported or newly surfaced findings that plausibly map to monitored products: HTTP/2 Bomb affecting monitored web servers, a SolarWinds Serv-U denial-of-service CVE, and a Visual Studio Code/github.dev token-theft disclosure. No fresh credible MongoDB-family findings were confirmed in this window.

**Finding 1: HTTP/2 Bomb denial-of-service issue affecting major web servers**

- Product: nginx, Apache HTTP Server, and Microsoft IIS
- Issue: HTTP/2 Bomb; CVE-2026-49975 is assigned for Apache httpd/mod_http2
- Severity: Not consistently stated by primary sources; GovCERT.HK labels the alert high threat, while public reporting describes severe availability impact
- Description: A remote HTTP/2 denial-of-service technique can cause excessive server-side memory use by combining HPACK header amplification with stalled HTTP/2 streams.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes nginx, Apache HTTP Server, and IIS. Credible reports explicitly name nginx, Apache httpd, and Microsoft IIS as affected when HTTP/2 is enabled.
- Source: GovCERT.HK: https://www.govcert.gov.hk/en/alerts_detail.php?id=1898; oss-sec: https://seclists.org/oss-sec/2026/q2/790; Radware: https://www.radware.com/security/threat-advisories-and-attack-reports/ai-discovered-http-2-bomb-affects-major-web-servers/

**Finding 2: SolarWinds Serv-U unauthenticated service-crash vulnerability**

- Product: SolarWinds Serv-U
- Issue: CVE-2026-28318
- Severity: High, CVSS 7.5 as listed by GitHub Advisory Database / NVD-sourced advisory data
- Description: SolarWinds Serv-U is reported to be susceptible to specially crafted unauthenticated POST requests using Content-Encoding: deflate that can crash the Serv-U service, causing denial of service.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes SolarWinds. Serv-U is a SolarWinds product, so this maps to the monitored product family even though the list does not name Serv-U separately.
- Source: GitHub Advisory Database: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4vx4-vp54-mwmc

**Finding 3: Visual Studio Code / github.dev token-theft disclosure**

- Product: Visual Studio Code / github.dev
- Issue: Publicly disclosed VS Code webview/github.dev token-theft issue; no CVE was available in the reviewed sources
- Severity: Not clearly stated by Microsoft or a CVE source; SecurityWeek describes it as severe
- Description: Public reporting says a crafted github.dev / VS Code webview flow could install or trigger malicious extension behavior and steal a GitHub OAuth token, potentially exposing repositories accessible to the user.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes Visual Studio Code, and the disclosure explicitly concerns VS Code's web-based github.dev experience. Vendor severity and CVE assignment were not available in the reviewed sources, so this should be treated as a caveated but relevant developer-tool finding.
- Source: SecurityWeek: https://www.securityweek.com/vs-code-vulnerability-allows-one-click-github-token-theft/; BleepingComputer: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/vs-code-zero-day-lets-hackers-steal-github-tokens-in-one-click/

**Reviewed but excluded**

- Cisco Unified Communications Manager CVE-2026-20230: fresh and credible, but it does not match the monitored Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, or Cisco Fabric Extender scope.
- WordPress plugin advisories newly listed on GitHub: excluded unless they match WordPress core or the monitored plugins Yoast SEO / Advanced Custom Fields; the reviewed hits were plugin-specific and not confirmed in the product list.
- Redis CVE-2026-23479 reposted analysis: excluded because the underlying Redis disclosure was from May 2026, outside the last-24-hour freshness window.
- Dell BSAFE SSL-J CVE-2025-46638: excluded because Dell BSAFE does not map to Dell SonicWall / SonicWall in the monitored list.
- OpenSSL-adjacent advisories involving third-party products or bindings: excluded where they did not clearly affect OpenSSL itself.

**Possible matches needing review**

No additional plausible-but-unconfirmed in-window matches were retained. The SolarWinds Serv-U item is included because it maps to the broader monitored SolarWinds product family; confirm whether Serv-U is deployed before prioritizing operational action.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for internet-facing HTTP/2 services using nginx, Apache HTTP Server, or IIS, and for teams that use github.dev/VS Code with GitHub authentication. SolarWinds environments should confirm whether Serv-U is present and exposed.
